prediction_text: Barack Obama is re-elected in 2012: the incumbent defeats Mitt Romney on 6 November 2012, in a competitive but ultimately clear result; the Mercury-retrograde Election Day brings counting/administrative confusion without reversing the outcome.
basis:
Card bears no tradition field; decided by genre: mundane/election astrology (WP-003 asked May 2012; election 6 Nov 2012 is the day Mercury turns retrograde).
Incumbency plus a competitive-but-not-collapsing chart favours retention; Mercury retrograde beginning on the day is read as procedural muddle (recount talk, delayed calls) rather than defeat of the incumbent — direction and mechanism stated separately.
